input.overview: Time Machine changes its upper target assembly between Future and Past through the Time Hole. In the Past, hit fixed targets 1 through 7 to advance Green Special and add a M-A-C-H-I-N-E letter. The drop banks and moving A-F targets build Red and Orange Special and bonus. Shoot the Time Bridge for Bonus X. Complete M-A-C-H-I-N-E, then return to the Time Hole to collect the Special.
input.simpleOverview: Shoot the Time Hole to move between Future and Past. In the Past, complete fixed targets 1 through 7 for Green Special and a M-A-C-H-I-N-E letter. Use the drop banks and moving A-F targets for Red and Orange Special, the Time Bridge for Bonus X, and the Time Hole after M-A-C-H-I-N-E is complete for Special.
input.summary: Use the Time Hole to put the machine in the state needed for your next target set. In the Past, finish 1 through 7; use the Time Bridge whenever Bonus X is the safer progress shot.

quickInfo.name: Build Specials
quickInfo.summary: Use the drop banks and moving A-F targets.

steps.text: Shoot the Time Hole to raise or lower the moving assembly and switch between Future and Past.
In the Past, complete fixed targets 1 through 7 to advance Green Special and add a M-A-C-H-I-N-E letter.
Use the drop-target banks and moving A-F targets to advance Red Special, Orange Special, and bonus.
Complete M-A-C-H-I-N-E, then shoot the Time Hole to collect the lit Special; use the Time Bridge to raise Bonus X along the way.

alternatives.title: Take Green Special
alternatives.when: Use this when the machine is already in the Past and the numbered set is nearly complete.

steps.text: Collect Green Special at its lit target before changing time again.
Repeat the Past target route and the Red Special route to add letters.
When the word is complete, return to the Time Hole for Special.

machineSetup: Check the Past-target, Red Special, Orange Special, M-A-C-H-I-N-E, and Special-award settings.
Test the Time Hole and moving assembly, fixed targets 1–7, moving A-F targets, drop banks, Time Bridge, and all Special lamps.

cautions.response: Confirm Future or Past before committing to a target sequence.
